clips.title: The story
paras: Spotted Sunfish are freshwater fish native to Lake Everstill in the Redridge Mountains. Renowned locally for their flavor, they are a staple commodity for Lakeshire's docks, though the growing murloc infestation makes procuring them hazardous.

Lake Everstill has long been celebrated for its spotted sunfish, which fetch a dependable price among local merchants and visitors alike. Dockmaster Baren keeps a steady trade in them at the Lakeshire piers, supplying food and commerce to a town under strain. However, the aggressive murloc tribes prowling the shallows have disrupted routine fishing, often stockpiling catches of their own that adventurers must recover by force.
